Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I bought my Spirit II E-310 as a replacement for an older grill from a different manufacturer who no longer had grate and flavorizer bar replacement available for my model.

On the whole, it's a great grill.  Very even heat distribution.  Classic solid Weber construction.  Looks great.  The composite plastic on the sides keeps you from burns if you accidentally brush the sides with your hand.  It's still hot but not like metal sides would be.

The iGrill3 mount is very handy and seemless looking.  I got one so I wouldn't accidentally burn my meats.  I assume it also would work with the iGrill2 which is a magnetic mount and it has the two stainless side tables.  

I only have two minor quibbles.  First, the knob throw is only a half turn from start/max to minimum intensity.  That means when trying to get all three burners the same intensity being off a bit means more than I'd like, so you have to be precise when setting them.

Second, the spring loaded gas gauge can be a bit "sticky."  It's useful to give your propane tank a bounce every few uses to get a more accurate reading.

But on the whole it's a wonderful, solidly built grill that cooks everything wonderfully.
Results.Title: Almost perfect

Results.ReviewText:
I bought the Spirit II a month ago, as I was looking for larger than a 2 burner, but small so that it would fit on a small porch. It looks great and seems to be cooking well,  but my issue is with some of the smaller items.  I went with Weber as they are supposed to be the be all end all of grills, but I am wondering if I should have saved a few hundred and bought a lesser brand name as the small intricacies are what you pay the money for.

The rear upper grill does not fit correctly in the unit no matter how many ways I put it in, when I lift or close the cover, it shifts. When I use a grill brush, it moves too, I am not sure if my unit was missing actual pegs to put the grill into, but it just does not look right just sitting in a u shaped peg versus being pushed into a circle peg that would prevent it from moving when the lid open and closes. Either my unit was missing correct holes, or that is just a design flaw in the Spirit II.

The side panels also do not work as expected. They are simple metal hooks to put the side panels on, but any weight more than a plate of 4 steaks causes it to be flimsy and fall off the peg. I lost a piece of chicken to my dog when I had a few plates on the ledge. I understand it is just a small ledge, but it should be able to hold all your meat.

The cook seems to be good on the grill, I was thinking about buying the Weber iGrill 2 with 4 Meat Probes and FREE Storage Bag and Temperature Magnet to see how great this thing can cook, but am dissuaded in buying a high end thermometer if the little things in it are going to be overlooked and I can just buy a cheap one.
Results.Title: Expected a little more from Weber Brand

Results.ReviewText: Had this for a couple of months and using it at least weekly.  Easy to assemble (there’s an app that supplements the printed instructions).  Heats up quickly - more propane used for cooking vs pre-heating.  Good temperature control.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is the best outdoor cooking investment I have ever made when it comes to grills. I usually buy the inexpensive ones that wear out in 3-4 years. This Weber is the greatest. Flares ups are minimal and it cooks so well that I put my meat on it and forget about it for a while. I also bought the heat probes for the weber so that Bluetooth technology is just great. I love my Weber and will let everyone I know that grills on the cheaper grills what a great investment it is. Thank you for your fine products.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill over a month ago and we simply LOVE this grill.  Minimal flare-ups, food cooks quicker, more evenly.  My wife used to loathe grilling food, not she wants to grill something every night and she does it herself.  So easy to light and to operate.  All I have to do is keep extra gas tanks on hand for her.
Results.Title: Wonderful Purchase

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Being a previous owner of Weber grills prior, I was not disappointed.  This grill is so easy to clean.  The grates are very easy to clean.  The grill starts up no problem.   Only issue I had was the gas regulator that came with the grill had a leak.  I called Weber and the next day I had a new one and it works awesome. Very happy!
Results.Title: As Expected

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The grill cooks evenly and heats quickly. Moving the grill from one location to another is very difficult because there are wheels on only one end, the grill itself is heavy and there is no easy way to grip the end that doesn’t have wheels in order to move it. I wish I had thought about that before I purchased.

45010001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
